categories.main_business_segments: New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc. operates primarily in educational services and livestreaming e-commerce. Its educational services include test preparation courses, non-academic tutoring, intelligent learning systems and devices, overseas study consulting, and educational materials and distribution. The livestreaming e-commerce business, conducted through its subsidiary East Buy, focuses on the sale of agricultural and other private label products via multiple online platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages an OMO (online-merge-offline) system integrating offline schools and online education platforms to enhance operational efficiency. It uses big data algorithms and a proprietary seven-step teaching method to tailor educational content and maintain teaching quality. The livestreaming e-commerce segment utilizes advanced live broadcasting technologies and supply chain management systems to support product sales and customer engagement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are students across China seeking educational programs ranging from test preparation to non-academic tutoring, as well as consumers purchasing products through East Buy's livestreaming e-commerce channels. The company serves students preparing for domestic and overseas admissions and assessment tests, and consumers interested in agricultural and lifestyle products. Major end markets include educational institutions, individual learners, and online retail consumers in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: New Oriental operates extensively across China with a physical network of 77 schools, 1,241 learning centers, and 8 bookstores in 70 cities, including major cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen. It also has a presence in Hong Kong and delivers online education nationwide. The livestreaming e-commerce business operates primarily in China through multiple online platforms including Douyin, Taobao, and its own app.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily downstream in the education value chain, delivering educational services and products directly to students and consumers. In the livestreaming e-commerce segment, it acts as a retailer and distributor, sourcing products from third-party suppliers and managing private label product development and sales through its platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding non-academic tutoring, intelligent learning systems, and digitalized smart study solutions. The company invests in content development, technology integration, and personalized learning experiences. It also focuses on growing its livestreaming e-commerce business by enhancing product offerings, supply chain management, and multi-channel marketing. Compliance with evolving regulatory requirements and innovation in AI and online education technologies are key R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through course fees from educational programs, including test preparation and tutoring services. Additional revenue streams include sales of educational materials and books, overseas study consulting fees, and product sales via livestreaming e-commerce platforms. The company also earns income from service fees paid by its variable interest entities and subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: New Oriental is a leading private education provider in China with a well-known brand and extensive nationwide network. It faces competition from other private education companies, online education platforms, and livestreaming e-commerce operators. Competitors may have greater resources or longer operating histories, but New Oriental differentiates itself through its brand recognition, teaching quality, breadth of offerings, and technology integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported total net revenues of approximately US$4.9 billion for the fiscal year ended May 31, 2025, with steady growth from prior years. It employs around 41,000 teachers and operates a large physical and online network. Despite regulatory challenges impacting certain segments, New Oriental has maintained profitability and positive operating margins in recent years. It has significant cash reserves and a shareholder return plan targeting at least 50% of net income for dividends and share repurchases over three years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: New Oriental emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and inspirational instruction supported by proprietary teaching content and methodologies. Its OMO system combines offline and online learning to provide personalized education tailored to student needs. The company leverages its strong brand reputation, extensive distribution channels, and technology capabilities to deliver differentiated educational services and products. In livestreaming e-commerce, it offers a wide selection of quality private label and third-party products with multi-channel access and engaging live content.
